idea: Every cell has a membrane, cytoplasm and ribosomes; animal and plant cells keep their DNA in a nucleus, plants add a wall, chloroplasts and a vacuole, and bacteria have no nucleus at all.

parameters.name: highlight
parameters.why: Picks out what all cells share and what only some kinds have.

moves: Choosing what to show brightens those organelles in each cell and fades the rest.
steps: The nucleus and mitochondria of animal and plant cells
